title: Zapier trigger or action times out at 30 seconds while the same call works in a local test
symptoms: Step times out in the Zap editor test
Polling trigger errors on accounts with large data sets
Action fails only for big payloads
cause: Polling triggers, create and search actions, REST hook processing and editor tests each get 30 seconds for requests and scripting. Input payloads are capped at 6 MB, or 35 MB from core 17.2.0, and HTTP responses at 20 MB.
fix: Fetch only the first page, filter on the server, and move long jobs to an async pattern with a callback.
apply: perform: async (z, bundle) => (await z.request({ url, params: { limit: 100, since: bundle.meta.page } })).data
affected: Zapier Platform CLI and UI integrations, as of 2026-10
